all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 680 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 12 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 49.1°S, 175.5°E, about 520 km from Dunedin.
This far north, they're roughly level with Winnipeg, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 90 m below the ship.
